lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate remaining sidecar.ts spawnSync sites and drop the node:child_process import

nextStoryContext: All ~14 remaining node:child_process spawnSync call sites in src/commands/sidecar.ts are now Bun.spawnSync (the 6 checkoutMainFn/proceedBranchFn sites were already migrated in US-001). The node:child_process spawnSync/SpawnSyncReturns import (was line 26) is fully removed. A new local helper `spawnSyncNodeShaped(cmd, args, opts?)` (defined just before parseGhPollResult) adapts Bun.spawnSync into the full legacy node SpawnSyncReturns shape (pid/output/stdout/stderr/status/signal) for the handful of call sites whose consumer type is owned by another file: `realSpawnFn` (tmux/session.ts's SpawnFn, used pervasively for hasSession/paneCountMutex/getOrchPaneId/openPaneInSession/notify/capture-pane), `postMergeSpawnFn` (release/post-merge.ts's SpawnFn), and the two closures inside makePlanPaneHelpers. All other sites (ghPollFn/updateBranchFn, makeProductionShipGatesFn, buildProductionShipPrStepDeps's ShipPrSpawnFn, the ship-phase/plan-phase loopSpawnFn x2, the two docker DockerProbe preflight probes, isPaneAlive, makeTeardownPlanPanesFn's kill-pane, preflightSpawnFn) use inline Bun.spawnSync + direct .success/.exitCode reads since their consumer types are simple same-file-adjacent shapes needing no node compatibility. src/commands/sidecar.ts's file-size-budget ceiling raised 3389->3411 (the shared adapter's net line cost) in the same commit, _ref updated. Full `bun run check:all` is green (5007 pass / 0 fail; typecheck/lint/file-size/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed SyncSubprocess shape used throughout this story's migration: exitCode:number (non-nullable, no ?? fallback needed unlike node's status:number|null), success:boolean, signalCode?:string, pid:number, stdout/stderr:Buffer when stdout/stderr:'pipe', no `encoding` option exists -- matches spawnSyncNodeShaped and every inline call site's new TextDecoder().decode(x instanceof Buffer ? x : ...) pattern.
